Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 10
Reason for Mistake: In the final step (Step 10), the Planner incorrectly concluded that "Allos gia to ekatommyrio has the director born later" and swapped the birthdates in the final answer. The WebSurfer correctly identified that Orestis Laskos was born on 1907-11-11 and Sam Irvin was born on 1956-06-14. Since 1956 is later than 1907, Sam Irvin (director of Elvira's Haunted Hills) was born later. The Planner failed to correctly compare the dates and erroneously attributed Sam Irvin's birthdate to Orestis Laskos and vice versa in the final output, leading to the wrong answer.
